From the Home of Cricket Manufacturing

Cricket equipment and clothing have been made in Sialkot for over a century — the sport's manufacturing heartland long before "sourcing" was a word. The sublimation printers, stitching lines and embroidery houses that serve international cricket are the same infrastructure your club kit runs on.

That is why a village club in Yorkshire, a grade side in Sydney or a corporate team in Dubai can order 15 sets — a quantity UK and Australian teamwear resellers mark up heavily precisely because they import it from here. Skip the reseller layer: factory-direct, DDP to your clubhouse in 3–7 days. See the wider sportswear range or test us first with a 20-piece trial.

Cricket Kit Questions

What cricket wear can FABRIOZA manufacture?

Full colored kits (sublimated shirts and trousers for T20/one-day formats), traditional whites for longer formats, training tees and shorts, travel tracksuits, caps and club merchandise like hoodies and polos — for clubs, schools, leagues, tape-ball teams and corporate tournaments.

What is the minimum order for custom cricket kits?

15–20 sets per design — sized for a single club side including spares. Club merchandise (hoodies, polos, caps) starts at 50 pieces with a 20-piece trial option.

How much does a custom cricket kit cost?

Sublimated colored kits (shirt + trousers) are quoted per design within 24 hours; comparable published baselines on our pricing page run $14–16 per sublimated set at kit MOQs, falling with volume. Whites are similar. Embroidered club crests and sponsor panels are itemized separately.

Why order cricket uniforms from Sialkot?

Sialkot is the traditional manufacturing base of cricket — Pakistani cricket gear has equipped the sport for decades, and the city's sublimation and stitching infrastructure was built on it. Buying from the source city means club-sized runs (15–20 sets) at factory-direct prices with 3–7 day DDP express delivery to the UK, Australia and the Gulf.

How long does a cricket kit order take?

Free kit mockup in 24–48 hours, pre-production sample in 5–7 business days, production 2–3 weeks, express DDP delivery 3–7 days — comfortably inside most pre-season windows.
